classification.difficultyReason: Requires recognising that either placement of a 60° angle produces an equilateral triangle.

content.prompt: An isosceles triangle has an interior angle of $60^{\circ}$. Find all the other angles.

answer.worked:
If $60^{\circ}$ is the unequal angle, let each remaining angle be $x^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{align*}2x+60&=180 &&\text{(angle sum of a triangle)}\\2x&=120\\x&=60\end{align*}$$
If $60^{\circ}$ is one of the equal angles, let the remaining angle be $y^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{align*}y+60+60&=180 &&\text{(angle sum of a triangle)}\\y+120&=180\\y&=60\end{align*}$$
In either case, the other angles are $60^{\circ}$ and $60^{\circ}$.

answer.short: An isosceles triangle with a $60^{\circ}$ angle is equilateral.
answer.worked: All three angles are $60^{\circ}$, so all three sides are equal. The triangle is equilateral.
